records.recognize: General notes and specification text about hydrants are never a physical hydrant instance. A project-wide plural rule (e.g. 'ALL NEW FIRE HYDRANTS ...', 'HYDRANTS ... AS PER ... STANDARDS') or text sitting under a WATERMAIN NOTES / GENERAL NOTES / NOTES: / SPECIFICATIONS heading is logged as a general_note_or_spec mention, not counted.
required_evidence: verbatim drawing text or described symbol
page + bbox on full-page coordinates
correct_examples: ALL NEW FIRE HYDRANTS TO BE AS PER CITY OF COQUITLAM STANDARDS
ALL NEW FIRE HYDRANT ASSEMBLIES ...
incorrect_examples: INSTALL NEW FIRE HYDRANT FROM EXISTING 200Ø WATERMAIN
limits: Notes gating is geometric (x -40..+600 pt, y 0..600 pt below heading): a real site callout directly under a NOTES heading would be suppressed (kept as a mention).
records.verification_evidence: real-drawing: general note correctly excluded in Blind Run 03 (Cumberland, v3, GPT-6 graded); Cedar Drive pages themselves not re-run

records.recognize: On a page with TYPICAL SECTION(S) / TYPICAL CROSS SECTION / TYPICAL DETAIL(S) / TYP. SECTION, a hydrant label with no site-action verb (INSTALL, SUPPLY, REPLACE, RELOCATE, REMOVE, ABANDON, DECOMMISSION, SALVAGE, TIE, CONNECT) is an illustration, never a physical instance.
required_evidence: verbatim drawing text or described symbol
page + bbox on full-page coordinates
correct_examples: Hydrant label inside a TYPICAL SECTIONS illustration with no action verb (e.g. 'PR. HYDRANT')
incorrect_examples: INSTALL NEW FIRE HYDRANT ... (plan-sheet callout with action verb)
limits: Page-level: on a mixed plan + typical-section sheet, verb-less plan labels like 'PR. HYDRANT' would be suppressed.
records.verification_evidence: synthetic-only (no typical-section hydrant case exercised on real drawings yet)

records.recognize: A callout 'TIE IN AT/TO/INTO [EXISTING] HYDRANT' is a tie-in action, not a hydrant body. A tie-in with no hydrant word (main-only tie-in) is not a hydrant tie-in.
required_evidence: verbatim drawing text or described symbol
page + bbox on full-page coordinates
correct_examples: ULVERTSTON AVENUE & FIFTH STREET TIE IN AT HYDRANT
incorrect_examples: ULVERTSTON AVENUE & MILL STREET TIE IN
TIE-IN AT EXISTING TEE
limits: 'AT HYDRANT' may be a location reference rather than a hydrant connection (Checker's uncertainty).
records.verification_evidence: synthetic tests + NON-BLIND Cumberland diagnostic agrees with Checker; awaiting fresh blind run

records.recognize: A hydrant's station comes from a matching profile label with its printed STA (e.g. 'HYDRANT TEE AND VALVE CLUSTER' at STA 2+170.745) before the nearest chainage label. Fall back to nearest chainage only when no matching profile label exists.
required_evidence: verbatim drawing text or described symbol
page + bbox on full-page coordinates
correct_examples: HYDRANT TEE AND VALVE CLUSTER  STA 2+170.745
incorrect_examples: Nearest chainage tick '2+200' near the plan callout
Non-hydrant profile labels
records.incorrect_examples_meaning: not used as the hydrant station when a matching profile label exists
limits: Geometric pairing assumes the STA label sits beside the profile label (<=20 pt).
One matching profile label per page assumed; multi-hydrant sheets without chainage stay on fallback.
records.verification_evidence: synthetic tests + NON-BLIND Cumberland diagnostic; side effect unchecked: p8 new hydrant now gets STA 2+009.015

records.recognize: A hydrant coverage / spacing / radius annotation (COVERAGE, SPACING or RADIUS in the label or the lines stacked directly below it, with no site-action verb) describes design criteria, not a hydrant. Log it as a mention, never count it.
required_evidence: verbatim drawing text or described symbol
page + bbox on full-page coordinates
correct_examples: PROPOSED 150m HYDRANT / COVERAGE RADIUS / AT APPROX. 300m SPACING(TYP.)
incorrect_examples: INSTALL NEW FIRE HYDRANT / MAINTAIN 1.5m SPACING FROM POLE
records.incorrect_examples_meaning: has a site-action verb (INSTALL): still a physical 'new' instance
limits: Stacked-line context is up to 3 lines directly below and overlapping horizontally.
A real callout that also says SPACING/RADIUS/COVERAGE without an action verb (e.g. 'PROPOSED HYDRANT, SEE COVERAGE') would be suppressed.
records.verification_evidence: synthetic tests + NON-BLIND re-run of Run 04 (FP gone); not yet blind-validated

records.recognize: Hydrant labels can be drawn as vector outlines with no text layer. When a page has drawing content but no hydrant word in its text layer (or no text layer at all), read the page with OCR (two orientations, 150 dpi) and send the OCR lines through the same classifier and gates. Mark them provenance=ocr, confidence low. Drop OCR lines that overlap the same text already in the text layer, so nothing is counted twice.
required_evidence: verbatim drawing text or described symbol
page + bbox on full-page coordinates
correct_examples: HYD-05 / PROPOSED HYDRANT & VALVE (TYP) / PER MMCD W4 (outlined text on plan sheets C06-C11)
incorrect_examples: The same words present in the text layer at the same place
records.incorrect_examples_meaning: not read again by OCR (no double count)
limits: Adds ~20-40 s per triggered page (large sheets); total OCR bounded by TI_HYD_OCR_BUDGET_S (default 900 s).
Repeated views of the same hydrant on adjacent sheets are not deduplicated unless explicit stations agree.
OCR misreads (O/0, merged words) can lose a label.
records.verification_evidence: synthetic tests + NON-BLIND re-run of Run 04: callouts now read on p8-p13, but repeat views are counted again and stations are nearest-chainage; needs Checker grading and a blind run

records.recognize: Same lesson as BR04-02 on a second tender: a plan callout drawn as graphics ('PROPOSED HYDRANT / RESTRAIN PIPE WITHIN 18m') must be read by OCR and typed 'new'. A detail sheet with text-layer hydrant text is not re-read by OCR.
required_evidence: verbatim drawing text or described symbol
page + bbox on full-page coordinates
correct_examples: PROPOSED HYDRANT / RESTRAIN PIPE WITHIN 18m.
HYDRANT STA. 1+070 (profile)
incorrect_examples: REMOVE TREES/BRUSH AS NEEDED FOR HYDRANT INSTALLATION
records.incorrect_examples_meaning: site-prep note, not a hydrant action
limits: Repeat view on p5 still counted (flag only).
Vertical profile label not recovered by OCR.
records.verification_evidence: NON-BLIND re-run of Run 05: found on p4, but the p5 repeat view is counted too (flagged possible_cross_sheet_duplicate); profile 'HYDRANT STA. 1+070' not read

records.recognize: One callout gives one status. If the callout has relocation wording, it is a relocate, even when it also says PROPOSED or NEW. Instances with the same evidence box and status are one instance.
required_evidence: verbatim drawing text or described symbol
page + bbox on full-page coordinates
correct_examples: PROPOSED HYDRANT RELOCATION
incorrect_examples: RELOCATE EXISTING HYDRANT and a separate INSTALL NEW HYDRANT callout elsewhere
records.incorrect_examples_meaning: two callouts: one relocate and one new
limits: tie_in + remove from one callout is still two statuses (unchanged earlier behaviour).
records.verification_evidence: synthetic tests + NON-BLIND re-run of Run 06 ({relocate: 1})

records.recognize: The same hydrant across sheets is one instance: same hydrant tag id (station ignored, sheets may use different chainage systems), same call-out text (>=20 chars, compatible station), or a '(TYP.)' call-out already counted by tags. Populate cross_sheet_duplicates.
required_evidence: verbatim drawing text or described symbol
page + bbox on full-page coordinates
correct_examples: SUPPLY & INSTALL FIRE HYDRANT ASSEMBLY AS PER MMD DWG W4 (TYP.) on C101 and the water plan
EXISTING HYDRANT PRESERVE AND PROTECT on C2, C4 and C4.1
HYD-07 on C08 and C11
incorrect_examples: two different hydrants with different text on two sheets
limits: Untagged repeats with different wording and no station are not merged (run04 p8 'EX HYD' may still repeat EX HYD-04).
records.verification_evidence: regression test on NON-BLIND page extract + NON-BLIND full re-run (not yet independently blind-validated)

records.recognize: A '(TYP.)' call-out applies to every tag-only hydrant label ('HYDRANT #1', 'HYD-05') on that sheet; each tag counts once with the call-out's status.
required_evidence: verbatim drawing text or described symbol
page + bbox on full-page coordinates
correct_examples: HYDRANT #1 / HYDRANT #2 + one 'SUPPLY & INSTALL FIRE HYDRANT ASSEMBLY (TYP.)'
incorrect_examples: tag with no status call-out on the sheet stays unresolved
records.verification_evidence: regression test on NON-BLIND page extract + NON-BLIND full re-run (not yet independently blind-validated)

records.recognize: Garbled text-layer words within edit distance 1 of the hydrant/status vocabulary (min length 6) are corrected at low confidence (provenance fuzzy_text_layer), only on lines without a hydrant word.
required_evidence: verbatim drawing text or described symbol
page + bbox on full-page coordinates
correct_examples: PROPOSLD HYDRANI
incorrect_examples: PROPOSED HYDRAULIC GRADE LINE
limits: Edit distance 1 only.
records.verification_evidence: regression test on NON-BLIND page extract + NON-BLIND full re-run (not yet independently blind-validated)

records.recognize: If a page's only hydrant words are legend/notes (no counted instance), OCR the page anyway; partial hydrant words at 150 dpi trigger a 300 dpi re-OCR of that region.
required_evidence: verbatim drawing text or described symbol
page + bbox on full-page coordinates
correct_examples: FIRE HYDRANT ASSEMBLY drawn as vector text
limits: Run09 p5 label is now surfaced but stays UNRESOLVED (no status word on the drawing) - still a miss as a count.
Run12 H1 counted from the C002 'PROPOSED FIRE HYDRANT' label; the p4 'INSTALL NEW ...' vector text not separately read.
Adds OCR time (up to 900 s budget per package).
records.verification_evidence: regression test on NON-BLIND page extract + NON-BLIND full re-run (not yet independently blind-validated)

page + bbox on full-page coordinates
correct_examples: detail 10 '6th St & 7th Ave' PROPOSED FIRE HYDRANT REPLACEMENT
incorrect_examples: inset frames on the plan sheet itself
records.verification_evidence: regression test on NON-BLIND page extract + NON-BLIND full re-run (not yet independently blind-validated)

required_evidence: verbatim drawing text or described symbol
page + bbox on full-page coordinates
correct_examples: REMOVE EXISTING / HYDRANT AND VALVE AND / REPLACE WITH NEW / HYDRANT ASSEMBLY (rotated, in inset)
limits: Inset gets no station rather than its own; true inset station reading not implemented.

records.recognize: 'TIE EXISTING ... HYDRANT LEAD TO ...' = existing hydrant in scope with a hydrant-lead tie-in; tie_in reported per item in tie_in_items.

page + bbox on full-page coordinates
correct_examples: TIE EXISTING 150Ø PVC HYDRANT LEAD TO PROPOSED 250Ø PVC WATER MAIN

records.recognize: A stacked block of >=6 short rows most starting EX./PR./PROPOSED is a legend even when rotated and without a LEGEND heading; legend rows are not instances and are not used to suppress real labels as possible duplicates.

page + bbox on full-page coordinates
correct_examples: PR. FIRE HYDRANT & VALVE ASSEMBLY / EX. FIRE HYDRANT & VALVE ASSEMBLY among EX. GAS MAIN, PR. WATERMAIN & VALVE
incorrect_examples: a single 'EX. FIRE HYDRANT' label on a plan

records.recognize: Plan and profile sheets with near-identical call-out text (>=85% similar, first 150 normalized chars) at stations within 25 m are one hydrant even without a hydrant number.

page + bbox on full-page coordinates
correct_examples: 'FIRE HYDRANT c/w 250x250x150 HFF TEE, THRUST BLOCKS...' p6 and '...HFF THRUST BLOCKS...' p9, both ~0+185
incorrect_examples: two different call-outs at the same station

records.recognize: Station = interpolation between adjacent chainage ticks along the alignment at the call-out leader end (fallback: label centre); extrapolate at most half a tick spacing past an end tick; nearest label only when no tick pair fits.
required_evidence: verbatim drawing text or described symbol
page + bbox on full-page coordinates
correct_examples: leader end at 0+185.7 between 0+100 and 0+200 ticks
incorrect_examples: snapping to nearest 0+200 label
records.verification_evidence: non-blind regression tests + non-blind re-runs 03-16; not blind-validated

records.recognize: A call-out starting with an action verb (REMOVE, RELOCATE, ...) is not a legend row even if it sits in a stacked short-row block.
required_evidence: verbatim drawing text or described symbol
page + bbox on full-page coordinates
correct_examples: REMOVE & DISPOSE / EXISTING FIRE HYDRANT
incorrect_examples: EX. FIRE HYDRANT legend row

page + bbox on full-page coordinates

incorrect_examples: SEE WATERMAIN TIE-IN DETAIL W2

required_evidence: verbatim drawing text or described symbol
page + bbox on full-page coordinates

incorrect_examples: access for hydrants 1, 2, 4, 5 and 10

page + bbox on full-page coordinates

records.recognize: 'REMOVE AND RELOCATE HYDRANT' is one relocate action: relocate beats remove in one call-out.

page + bbox on full-page coordinates
correct_examples: REMOVE AND RELOCATE HYDRANT 0.3m FROM PROPERTY LINE.
incorrect_examples: REMOVE AND REPLACE HYDRANT (= remove + new)
limits: Only within one call-out; a separate REMOVE call-out still counts.

records.recognize: RAISE / LOWER / ADJUST / INSULATE / INSTALL INSULATION AROUND a hydrant = existing hydrant with in-scope work (status existing, work_on_existing=true), never 'new'. Such action call-outs are not legend rows.
required_evidence: verbatim drawing text or described symbol
page + bbox on full-page coordinates
correct_examples: INSTALL INSULATION AROUND HYDRANT AND VALVE BOX PER OPSD 1109.030
RAISE HYDRANT 0.3m WITH RISER
incorrect_examples: ADJUST EXISTING MANHOLES, FIRE HYDRANTS ... (numbered general note)
limits: Scope (in vs out) is reported via work_on_existing only; grader keeps separate scores.

records.recognize: A short (<=4 line) action-verb hydrant call-out whose hydrant line has a leader is a site call-out even when it sits in the column below a NOTES heading.
required_evidence: verbatim drawing text or described symbol
page + bbox on full-page coordinates
correct_examples: RAISE HYDRANT 0.3m WITH RISER (leader to hydrant)
incorrect_examples: Numbered note text under CONSTRUCTION NOTES with no leader
limits: Needs a vector leader within 8-12 pt of the hydrant line.
records.verification_evidence: synthetic tests + NON-BLIND re-run of the graded package only; not blind-validated

records.recognize: A second call-out with identical wording that has its own leader to a different hydrant position is a separate hydrant. Identical text alone is never grounds for suppression or cross-sheet merging; duplicates need matching position or station.
required_evidence: verbatim drawing text or described symbol
page + bbox on full-page coordinates
correct_examples: two 'REMOVE AND RELOCATE HYDRANT 0.3m FROM PROPERTY LINE. RAISE HYDRANT 0.3m WITH RISER.' call-outs on one sheet, leaders to two hydrants ~100 m apart
incorrect_examples: the same call-out repeated on a plan/profile or overlap sheet at the same station (still a duplicate)
limits: Needs a resolvable leader or distinct station; identical call-outs with no leader and no station are still treated as repeats.
records.verification_evidence: real-drawing NON-BLIND re-run of the graded package only; not blind-validated. Rule record written retroactively in v10 (code shipped in v9).

records.recognize: A leader drawn as one multi-segment path whose first vertex sits just outside the text box still gives the station (its far end).
required_evidence: verbatim drawing text or described symbol
page + bbox on full-page coordinates
correct_examples: RELOCATE EXISTING HYDRANT TO THE PROPERTY LINE (dog-leg leader)
limits: Leaders made of separate unconnected paths are still not chained.
records.verification_evidence: synthetic tests + NON-BLIND re-run of the graded package only; not blind-validated

records.recognize: A stand-alone survey label 'HYD.' (optionally with a '-O-' / '-+-' symbol) is an existing hydrant; it is never a note or typical-section reference. Repeat sheets that put the same label at the same position (e.g. pavement-marking plans) are duplicates.
required_evidence: verbatim drawing text or described symbol
page + bbox on full-page coordinates
correct_examples: HYD.
O- HYD.
-O- HYD.
incorrect_examples: HYDRO
HYD. UNION (fitting text)
TOP OPERATING NUT ON FIRE HYDRANT (benchmark)

records.recognize: OCR time is capped per page (TI_HYD_OCR_PAGE_CAP_S, default 240 s) so one slow page cannot exhaust the whole budget and leave later sheets unread.
required_evidence: verbatim drawing text or described symbol
page + bbox on full-page coordinates
correct_examples: run18 p2 OCR ran 4123 s in the blind run; p3-p10 then skipped

records.verification_evidence: synthetic tests + NON-BLIND re-run of the graded package only; not blind-validated

records.recognize: Station-less hydrant call-outs (profile labels, servicing/grading-plan repeats) citing the same standard drawing (OPSD/OPSS/MMCD/SD) and status as stationed plan call-outs are duplicates, when there are at most two repeats per stationed call-out.
required_evidence: verbatim drawing text or described symbol
page + bbox on full-page coordinates
correct_examples: PROP. FIRE HYDRANT AS PER OPSD 1105.010 (C300)
INSTALL FIRE HYDRANT AS PER OPSD 1105.010 (C400 profile)
incorrect_examples: two stationed call-outs with the same OPSD reference (both kept)
limits: If every sheet is station-less nothing is deduped; a genuinely separate station-less hydrant citing the same standard would be dropped.
records.verification_evidence: synthetic tests + NON-BLIND re-run of the graded package only; not blind-validated

records.recognize: A plan call-out 'HYDRANT TEE' is a new hydrant ONLY when its leader ties it to a drawn hydrant symbol; a bare mention with no leader is logged as a mention, not counted. Counted only when the page has no other counted new call-out for it; a doubled text-layer copy within 12 pt is one hydrant. Legend entries, table rows (e.g. storm flow table 'HYDRANT 2-6') and detail/typical sheets are never counted.
required_evidence: verbatim drawing text or described symbol
page + bbox on full-page coordinates
correct_examples: 'HYDRANT TEE' at a plan station on a street plan/profile sheet
incorrect_examples: legend column 'HYDRANT'
storm flow table row 'HYDRANT 2-6'
TYPICAL RURAL HYDRANT INSTALLATION detail sheet
bare 'HYDRANT TEE' text with no leader to a symbol
limits: A 'HYDRANT TEE' label on a page that already has another counted new call-out is treated as corroboration only.
records.verification_evidence: real-drawing NON-BLIND re-run of the graded package only; not blind-validated.

records.recognize: Station interpolation uses chainage ticks from one alignment only: a tick pair whose text directions disagree (|dot|<0.9) is skipped unless both are axis-aligned.
required_evidence: verbatim drawing text or described symbol
page + bbox on full-page coordinates
correct_examples: 0+080 / 0+100 ticks along Street I bracket the HYDRANT TEE
incorrect_examples: ticks of a crossing street at another angle
limits: Non-blind rerun: run21 HN6 still ~20 m off the key; stations remain approximate.
records.verification_evidence: real-drawing NON-BLIND re-run of the graded package only; not blind-validated.

records.recognize: 'TEE & GATE VALVE w/FIRE HYDRANT' (or 'TEE w/HYD') is a new hydrant assembly even without the word NEW resolving status; a call-out split over a matchline (adjacent pages, same sheet size, opposite ends of the axis) is one hydrant.
required_evidence: verbatim drawing text or described symbol
page + bbox on full-page coordinates
correct_examples: NEW 250mmøx150mmø TEE & GATE VALVE w/FIRE HYDRANT
incorrect_examples: the same assembly repeated on both sides of a matchline (one hydrant)
limits: Matchline pairing needs station-less instances near opposite sheet ends; otherwise they stay separate.
records.verification_evidence: real-drawing NON-BLIND re-run of the graded package only; not blind-validated.

records.recognize: Cross-sheet dedupe never merges on identical text alone: both instances must share a station (within 25 m) or position (centres within 150 pt), or be a matchline continuation.
required_evidence: verbatim drawing text or described symbol
page + bbox on full-page coordinates
correct_examples: two 'REMOVE EXISTING FIRE HYDRANT AND VALVE.' call-outs at different corners
incorrect_examples: a repeat sheet showing the same call-out at the same spot
limits: Rows without a bbox (spec rows) keep the v0.9 text-based behaviour.

records.recognize: On a page that already has counted text call-outs and many grey vector glyphs (>=300), a supplementary OCR pass may add remove/relocate call-outs drawn as vector text, if >150 pt from existing instances; low confidence.

page + bbox on full-page coordinates
correct_examples: vector-only grey 'REMOVE EXISTING FIRE HYDRANT AND VALVE.'
incorrect_examples: any OCR-only 'new' or 'existing' text (not added)

records.recognize: Station is read where the call-out block's own leader ends: prefer a pure-black leader leaving the block over grey fitting-list leaders; for curved polylines prefer the one starting nearest the label; interpolate between the bracketing ticks of the same alignment row (same direction) nearest the symbol, never a mixed plan/profile pair. If a leader reaches the symbol but no bracketing tick pair exists, the station is emitted as UNRESOLVED (no nearest-label guess).
required_evidence: verbatim drawing text or described symbol
page + bbox on full-page coordinates
incorrect_examples: grey fitting-list leader
tick pair joining two streets
limits: Leader colour heuristic: packages drawing hydrant leaders in grey fall back to longest leader.

records.recognize: A hydrant station is evidence-based or UNRESOLVED. L1: the hydrant symbol, tee or connection on pipe geometry of the correct alignment (leader end lies on a drawn pipe segment), measured between verified bracketing chainage ticks of that alignment. L2: a leader endpoint, or an explicit station label tied to the hydrant (station in the call-out text, or a hydrant profile label). L3 (no leader): a uniquely identifiable symbol with no competing hydrant candidate nearby; proximity alone is never enough and with several candidates nothing is guessed. L4: UNRESOLVED; detection and status are kept when independently supported. The centre of a call-out text box is never a station anchor. Curved alignments use arc-length projection along the alignment polyline; straight ones the chord projection.
required_evidence: verbatim drawing text or described symbol
page + bbox on full-page coordinates
correct_examples: run23 p3 leader end at the tee x~1535 between 1+100/1+120 -> ~1+116
run21 HYDRANT TEE leaders to the tee
incorrect_examples: floating 'PROPOSED FIRE HYDRANT' text between ticks with no leader/symbol -> UNRESOLVED
non-hydrant profile label 'TIE-IN AT EXISTING TEE STA ...' never used

records.why_label_centre_unreliable: Call-out text is placed wherever there is room on the sheet, often 50-300 pt from the hydrant; on Tofino run23 the text block (x1228-1471) sat around 1+100 while the tee was at x~1535 (1+116.9), a 17 m error against a ±5 m standard. Stations taken from the text position measure the label, not the hydrant.

records.recognize: A tick pair used for interpolation must be adjacent on one alignment row: reject a pair when a tick of an intermediate station lies nearer to either end than the chord, and reject pairs wider than the modal consecutive station interval whose pt-per-metre scale differs by more than 5% from the median nearest-neighbour scale.

page + bbox on full-page coordinates
incorrect_examples: run24 p3 cross-row pair 10+140 (top row) -> 10+240 (bottom row)
limits: Needs at least three ticks on a row to estimate the scale.

records.recognize: A composite note 'NEW HYDRANT ... EXISTING HYDRANT(S) TO BE REMOVED' with leaders is a site call-out even below a NOTES heading; each distinct leader end is owned separately: an end at a stroked circle-with-rays (the legend/survey 'FH' existing-hydrant symbol) is an existing removal; else an end at a project tag is that new hydrant; else unresolved. A streetlight (solid ellipse or 'L' circle) is never the existing-hydrant symbol. The same symbol on overlapping sheets without a call-out adds nothing (one physical removal).
required_evidence: verbatim drawing text or described symbol
page + bbox on full-page coordinates
correct_examples: run26 p3 leader (912,622) -> circle-with-rays [912.8,628.8,922.3,638.3] ~1+139 -> one removal
p3 leader (1259,646) -> existing hydrant EXH-1
incorrect_examples: leader end on neither tag nor symbol (p3 (1963,1218)) -> unresolved
limits: Symbol test is vector-only (7-13 pt unfilled circle + >=3 short diagonal rays); raster or differently drawn legends fall to tag/unresolved.
Removal is only counted when a call-out leader reaches the symbol; uncalled-out existing symbols are not counted (Edward St FH: documented, excluded from scoring).
